_how_it_works: Loaded by refresh_cafrs.py, which subtracts every id here from the default plan set on every run, local or hosted -- 'blocked_by' does not affect that. Explicit positional plan_ids on the CLI bypass the filter. scripts/waf_blocked_ids.py reads 'blocked_by' to decide which ids the Mac Mini job should name.
